item.description:
LiveCopilot 2.5.0

  • 完整会话历史：多轮问答、引用、搜索、导出和自动命名；支持手动重命名。
  • 本地模型真实加载自检、诊断信息及明确恢复指引。
  • 推荐 Zipformer 中英双语识别；新版微调 Laya 从引导页下载，安装包不包含模型权重。
  • 悬浮窗和设置布局优化；保留现有配置、凭证、模型与历史。

Laya 本地运行需要 Apple Silicon。模型下载约 767 MB，需额外磁盘空间。

English

  • Searchable multi-turn session history with citations, export, automatic titles and rename controls.
  • Real local-model loading checks, diagnostics and recovery guidance.
  • Recommended Zipformer bilingual speech recognition. Download the pinned fine-tuned Laya model during setup; no Laya weights in the small installer.
  • Refined native settings and floating window; existing settings, credentials, models and history are preserved.

Local Laya requires Apple Silicon. Model setup downloads approximately 767 MB and requires additional disk space.

LiveCopilot v2.3.0

  • **更简单的首次配置**：按语音语言和知识库需求推荐本地能力，展示真实准备状态及下载资源，支持先用现有能力开始使用。
  • **更清晰的模型选择**：新增推荐模型配置、推理深度与处理模式选择，集中展示延迟、生成速度和价格参考；估算数据明确标注。
  • **更顺畅的密钥配置**：可直接配置语音 OpenAI 密钥，已保存密钥检查提供明确反馈，连接测试区分常见失败原因。
  • **更及时的更新提醒**：主窗口提醒、菜单栏入口和设置页统一管理更新，实时使用期间不打扰；版本号统一为三段式。
  • **更自由的悬浮窗**：默认保持自动贴边，也可关闭自动贴边后自由拖动到桌面任意位置。
  • Guided setup recommends local capabilities by language and knowledge-base needs, with clear readiness/download status and a quick-start option.
  • Model recommendations, reasoning and processing controls, latency, throughput and pricing references are presented together. Estimates remain labeled.
  • Speech-key setup, saved-key checks and connection-test feedback are clearer.
  • Unified update reminders in the main window, menu and settings stay quiet during live use, with semantic version comparison.
  • Turn off automatic edge docking to freely position the floating window.

LiveCopilot 2.2.0

  • 混合知识回答：默认结合你的资料与模型通用知识回答，也可切换为「仅知识库」。引用只展示实际采用的资料。
  • 中英文自由切换：回答语言默认 Auto，跟随当前问题；悬浮窗可直接选择中文或 English，支持跨语言使用知识库。
  • 更及时的自动建议：改进连续提问和「讲讲」「告诉我」等表达的识别，优化触发与首次检索等待；新增首字耗时和生成状态提示。
  • 更清晰的模型选择：提供语音识别选型提示，以及来自 Artificial Analysis、OpenRouter 的首 Token 延迟和生成速度参考。OpenAI 默认模型更新为 GPT-6.1 Sol，支持推理档位的预设在切换时优先选择 low。
  • 共享时保护悬浮窗：已通过腾讯会议整个屏幕共享与本地录制验证，对方画面隐藏悬浮窗，本机仍可正常查看和输入；同时保护已验证的苹果拼音候选条，输入时保持箭头鼠标。
  • 更顺手的操作：语言和知识模式使用一级菜单，统一设置页样式，并支持自定义悬浮窗显示快捷键。

English

  • Hybrid knowledge combines your documents with general model knowledge by default. Knowledge Base Only remains available, with citations limited to documents actually used.
  • Flexible answer language follows each question in Auto mode. Choose 中文 or English directly in the overlay, including answers based on documents in another language.
  • Faster automatic suggestions better recognize consecutive questions and requests such as “explain” or “tell me,” with improved triggering, retrieval preparation, and visible first-answer timing.
  • Clearer model selection adds speech-model guidance and latency/throughput references from Artificial Analysis and OpenRouter. OpenAI now defaults to GPT-6.1 Sol; supported reasoning presets start at low when selected.
  • Overlay sharing protection has been verified with Tencent Meeting full-screen sharing and local recording: the overlay remains usable locally while hidden from the shared image. Verified Apple Pinyin candidates are protected, and text entry keeps the arrow pointer.
  • Simpler controls offer single-level language and knowledge menus, consistent settings pages, and a customizable overlay shortcut.
